title: SMOKED BEEF WITH CREAM
instructions: --Place the finely minced beef in a stew-pan with a lump of butter, cooking it for two minutes, and moisten slightly with a little cream, add two tablespoonfuls of bechamel sauce. Serve as soon as it boils up.
